# PeelAways

> > PeelAways provides innovative waterproof disposable sheets and caregiver planning tools designed for elderly care, incontinence management, and potty training.

PeelAways specializes in disposable waterproof bedding solutions and digital caregiver resources. Founded by Diana L. Magda, the company has earned recognition as Caregivers' #1 Product of the Year and serves families managing incontinence, mobility challenges, and potty training needs.

## Key Topics

- Waterproof disposable sheets
- Incontinence protection
- Elderly care solutions
- Caregiver planning tools
- Disposable bedding
- Potty training guides
- Mattress protection
- Mobility-impaired bedding
- Digital Caregiver Planner
- Subscribe & Save program
- Nighttime protection
- Senior caregiver resources
- Waterproof mattress covers
- Incontinence products
- Caregiver support
